headline: DeepSeek surges past 24%, stealth holds firm at #1
summary: DeepSeek jumped 2.8 percentage points overnight to claim 24.1% of token share, its strongest day yet, while stealth's space-bunny-alpha extended its all-time record streak to day 4 at 19.4%. Two models entered the rankings and two dropped out; Xiaomi's mimo-v2.6-flash climbed two spots to rank 3.
highlights: DeepSeek now at 24.1% (+2.8% in one day), riding a 30-day surge of +5.6%
stealth/space-bunny-alpha holds rank 1 with 19.4%, day 4 of all-time high streak
Top 3 providers (DeepSeek, stealth, OpenAI) control 54.5% of token share
Xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-flash jumped to rank 3 (+2 spots); mimo-v2.6-pro debuted at rank 22
OpenAI/gpt-6-astra dropped 12 ranks in a day, losing 0.5% share
Two new entrants: openai/gpt-5.6-terra and google/gemma-4-26b; two dropouts: meta/muse-spark-1.3 and qwen/qwen3.8-27b
